clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: Welcome to Buckland Blocks. There is no hurry. Take a look around, find your bearings, and choose what to build first.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: A block in your inventory is a possibility. A few more, and you will have the start of a shelter.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: Your tool is ready. Check the block you are aiming at before you swing.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: Try combining materials at a crafting table. The recipe tells you what the finished item needs.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: The light is changing. You might want to finish your shelter before exploring farther.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: Your health has dropped. Find somewhere safer before deciding what to do next.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: You are in trouble. Step away from danger and make survival your next job.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: World saved. Your changes will be here when you return.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: The save has not been confirmed. Check the message on screen before leaving.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: There it is. One resource collected, and a little more freedom to make something useful.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: Your first crafted item. Every useful tool starts with a handful of ordinary materials.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: Your inventory is full. Make room before you pick anything else up.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: That tool has seen a lot of work. Consider making a replacement before the next big job.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: That is a long way down. Check your footing before you cross.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: That landing hurt. Give yourself a moment to get clear of the edge.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: Heat can turn raw material into something more useful. Watch the fuel as well as the result.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: Back to familiar ground. You can repair, sort your supplies, or head out again.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: You are back. Your next attempt starts with what you learned from the last one.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: That is enough for now if you want to stop. Save your world so the next visit starts smoothly.

clips.speaker: Field guide
clips.text: Voice guidance is optional. You can turn it off at any time in Settings.
